title: Thousands separators on the HTML invoice
prompt: On the HTML invoice (`render_html` in `app/invoice.py`), show prices with thousands separators, so 1234.5 is shown as 1,234.50. Other outputs, such as the CSV export, must stay exactly as they are. Add tests in `tests/test_invoice.py`. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
